extraction_notes: Reported 0.57 µmol/g dry weight. Converted to 101.0553 mg/kg dry weight using MW 177.29 g/mol: µmol/g × 177.29 = mg/kg. uncertainty_notes: Beneforté is a glucoraphanin-rich experimental cultivar and may differ from ordinary retail broccoli.
